intro: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz caused a clumsy cargo accident on the Ratchet docks, allowing a petty troublemaker named Mad Magglish to snatch a priceless vintage bottle. The vintage—a 99-Year-Old Port sent directly from Baron Revilgaz to Gazlowe—must be recovered from the shadows of the Wailing Caverns before the dockmaster fires the negligent crane operator.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.
Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.
Maybe you're brave enough to find him?

clips.title: Progress
paras: The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.
If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.
Thank you, friend. Nicely done, I say!
